harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.0.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.0.20.0/24). Firewall policy permits only node2->node3 TCP/5432 and refuses every other cross-network connection in both directions. Verified via falsification testing (baseline default-deny, allow-rule effect, a forwarding-pairing misconfiguration that over-permitted traffic was caught via testing and corrected). Completed mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 has eth0 (mgmt/br-lan), plus unused eth1/eth2; node2/node3 have enp1s0 (mgmt) plus unused enp8s0
Configured node1 UCI network: interface lana on eth1 (10.0.10.1/24), interface lanb on eth2 (10.0.20.1/24)
Configured node2 NetworkManager connection 'lan-a' on enp8s0 (10.0.10.2/24) with static route to 10.0.20.0/24 via 10.0.10.1
Configured node3 NetworkManager connection 'lan-b' on enp8s0 (10.0.20.2/24) with static route to 10.0.10.0/24 via 10.0.20.1
Opened tcp/5432 in node3's local firewalld public zone so the service-level port is reachable once the router permits it
Created OpenWrt firewall zones lana and lanb (input=REJECT, output=ACCEPT, forward=REJECT) and rule Allow-node2-to-node3-pg (src=lana, dest=lanb, proto=tcp, dest_port=5432, target=ACCEPT)

Found and corrected a misconfiguration: an initial forwarding src=lana dest=lanb pairing unconditionally opened all lana->lanb traffic (caught via nc test on port 22 succeeding when it should not); removed it, restored the pre-existing lan->wan forwarding entry that had been accidentally deleted in the process, and confirmed the specific ACCEPT rule alone enforces default-deny plus the one permitted port
Verified end-to-end pre-restart: node2->node3:5432 succeeds; node2->node3:22 and :80 refused; node3->node2 on any port including 5432 refused
Captured baseline boot_id, uptime, and config/service state on all three nodes
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded 'reboot', rebooted node2 and node3 via backgrounded 'sudo systemctl reboot', one node at a time
Polled each node until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id and uptime reset to 0 on all three
Re-verified interface/route/firewall config persisted after each restart and re-ran the full connectivity test matrix after all three restarts, confirming the policy still holds

evidence.requirement: node2 (lan-a) can reach node3 (lan-b) on TCP 5432
evidence.summary: nc -zv from node2 to 10.0.20.2:5432 succeeds (Connected) both before and after each node restart

evidence.requirement: All other node2->node3 connections refused
evidence.summary: nc -zv from node2 to 10.0.20.2:22 and :80 returns Connection refused consistently, including after all three restarts

evidence.requirement: All node3->node2 connections refused (reverse direction), including port 5432
evidence.summary: nc -zv from node3 to 10.0.10.2:5432 and :22 both return Connection refused

evidence.requirement: Router/firewall config is correct and not an accidental full-open (falsification)
evidence.summary: Initial forwarding pairing lana->lanb caused port 22 to also connect (cmd-afd32a884eb14bae); removed the forwarding pairing, restored lan->wan forwarding, retested and confirmed only 5432 passes (cmd-49f57af1d52d4b5c)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e1a7c12b..., uptime 4 min, firewall/network services running, eth1/eth2 addressed, 72 firewall rule lines present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged immediately; subsequent poll shows boot_id changed to 55610a67... and uptime reset to 0 min

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered state/services and cluster policy after restart
evidence.summary: UCI firewall zones/rule and eth1/eth2 addresses persisted; firewall and network services active; end-to-end 5432-allow/22-refuse policy re-verified

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d4784d1b..., uptime 4 min, lan-a NetworkManager connection activated with correct IP/route

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged immediately; poll after transient connection errors (expected during reboot) shows boot_id changed to 9acc2fde... and uptime reset to 0 min

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: recovered state/services and cluster policy after restart
evidence.summary: enp8s0 IP and static route to 10.0.20.0/24 persisted; end-to-end 5432-allow/22-refuse policy re-verified

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 984a7d52..., uptime 4 min, lan-b NetworkManager connection activated with correct IP/route, firewalld port 5432/tcp open

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot acknowledged immediately; poll after transient connection errors (expected during reboot) shows boot_id changed to cebec289... and uptime reset to 0 min

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: recovered state/services and cluster policy after restart
evidence.summary: enp8s0 IP, static route, and firewalld port 5432/tcp persisted; end-to-end policy re-verified in both directions after all three restarts
